gen-dafont-groovy-gf-armata: Loose, funky and a bit squeezed shut: Groovy's c nearly closes its mouth, while Armata leaves generous gaps between its characters. Shut heading letters against open body ones give it real tension.
gen-dafont-groovy-gf-athiti: Approachable and contemporary, the body text shows a see-through gap in every s and a high mean line. Athiti stays open where Groovy nearly shuts, and that push-pull is the best thing here.
gen-dafont-groovy-gf-atkinson-hyperlegib: Atkinson Hyperlegible reads plainly, its capitals and ascenders clipped short beside the lowercase and its s terminals set wide apart. Groovy's nearly closed c gives that open body something to lean on.

Friendly Groovy leads, tight-lipped in its c and loosely tracked. Atkinson Hyperlegible Mono then runs on with stencil-bridge spacing stretched wide and open counters that breathe into the white space across a whole paragraph.

A pencil-line consistency runs through Groovy, though its c nearly seals shut behind a narrow, tight slit. Atkinson Hyperlegible Next counters with washer-big lowercase eyes and rounds left unlatched.
gen-dafont-groovy-gf-biryani: Biryani keeps every e wide-eyed and every small counter unclogged, with strokes that never swell or thin. Groovy handles the funk up top, while Biryani handles the clarity below.
gen-dafont-groovy-gf-blinker: Groovy loosens its lowercase and nearly seals each c into a slit, while Blinker holds its lines steady and its apertures open. Groovy brings the personality, Blinker the easy readability.
gen-dafont-groovy-gf-carrois-gothic: Groovy twists every stem, bowl and tail from the same rope-like line, with a c that almost closes. Carrois Gothic does the reverse, with a high-set x-height, plus a generous c.
gen-dafont-groovy-gf-carrois-gothic-sc: Groovy builds every letter on a monoweight skeleton, with a slit where the c almost shuts. Carrois Gothic SC opens every curve and holds capitals close to lowercase height, so the two trade tight for open.
gen-dafont-groovy-gf-chivo: Chivo packs its lowercase up toward the caps and lets daylight through every curve. And Groovy, with its nearly shut c, makes a lively opener, so give it extra size over Chivo.
